recommendation: 现有不动 for the production OCR stack as the default path. New measured evidence: on text quality X1F halves R0's character error (0.086 vs 0.160 strict; narrow 0.038 vs 0.125; EN WER 0.10 vs 0.30) and reads checkbox states, negations and the superscript footnote that R0 structurally misses; on dense numeric tables the OTSL-to-text path concatenates cells (digits present, tokens scrambled) and exact-token number recall trails R0 (0.73 vs 0.92; digit-present 0.89). Cost on this CPU: 57-235 s per page vs ~16 s, via the declared fp32/mapping variant - the upstream bf16 runtime cannot prefill a page here. A hybrid reading layer (RapidOCR default + Xiaomi for checkbox/low-res/handwriting-like difficulty flags) is the evidence-backed direction for ROOT to consider; integration and EvidenceSpan alignment (X1F has bbox=null/confidence=null) remain reading-layer work outside this card.
